segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ מוּלְיָאר הַגָּרוּף שׁוֹתִין הֵימֶנּוּ בְּשַׁבָּת. אַנְטִיכֵי, אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁגְּרוּפָה אֵין שׁוֹתִין הֵימֶנָּה.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» In this mishna, the Sages discuss two vessels used for heating water. With regard to «a mulyar,» a bronze vessel into which coals are placed in an outer compartment and water is placed into an adjacent inner compartment, whose coals were «swept, one may drink from it on Shabbat.» With regard to «an antikhi,» which is a vessel with a different configuration, «even if» its coals were «swept, one may not drink from it» on Shabbat.

moves.summary: A swept mulyar may be drunk from
An antikhi may not, even if swept

positions.claim: one may drink from a swept mulyar but not from an antikhi even if swept
